CONDDESC_BUFF_AGILE: Creatures with Agile have an additional, independent chance to dodge attacks.
CONDDESC_MINION_ANIMATEDWEAPON: When the Animated Weapon's master attacks, it deals additional damage equal to the highest total stat from all of its Artifact's Stat Slots.
CONDDESC_MINION_ANIMATEDGEM: After the Animated Gem's master manually casts a spell, this minion casts one of its master's Spell Gems as well, chosen randomly.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_DISARMED: Disarmed creatures lose the benefits from their equipped Artifact, other than health.
CONDDESC_BUFF_INVISIBLE: Invisible creatures cannot be manually targeted by enemy attacks or spells. This buff is removed after the creature takes an action.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_CONFUSED: Confused creatures have a 50% chance to attack or cast harmful spells on their allies.
CONDDESC_BUFF_PROFICIENT: Proficient creatures gain 30% more benefits from their Artifact's Stat Slots.
CONDDESC_BUFF_SPLASH: Creatures with Splashing deal 50% of their damage to enemies adjacent to the target they attack.
CONDDESC_BUFF_SAVAGE: Savage creatures have an additional, independent chance to deal critical damage with attacks.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_BURNED: Creatures with Burning take damage based on the inflictor's intelligence each turn.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_SCORN: Creatures with Scorned cannot attack. Overwrites Silenced.
CONDDESC_BUFF_REBIRTH: Creatures with Rebirth are resurrected with 50% health when they die.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_SILENCE: Creatures with Silenced cannot cast spells. Overwrites Scorned.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_BLIGHT: Creatures with Blighted cannot be healed and take damage from healing effects equal to 50% of the effect.
CONDDESC_BUFF_BARRIER: Barrier absorbs a certain amount of damage. After the maximum amount of damage is dealt, the buff is removed. Barrier strength cannot exceed 200% of a creature's highest stat when this buff is applied.
CONDDESC_BUFF_SHELL: Shelled negates the next incoming attack or spell.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_SNARED: Creatures with Snared are stuck at the bottom of the Timeline until they break free. They have a 10% chance to break free at the start of each creature's turn.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_SLEEP: Creatures with Sleeping cannot act until they either take damage or this debuff wears off.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_FROZEN: Frozen creatures are unable to act until they thaw, and have a 25% chance to thaw at the start of their turn. This chance doubles after each of their turns.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_STONE: Creatures with Stone cannot dodge or deal critical damage.
CONDDESC_MINION_UNSTABLEHORROR: This minion's master has 5% more stats for each Unstable Horror it has. After this minion's master defends or provokes, it deals damage to all enemies equal to 10% of its master's highest stat for each stack of Unstable Horror it has. Maximum of 9 stacks.
CONDDESC_MINION_WRITHELING: After this minion's master takes damage from an attack or spell, each Writhelings afflicts a random enemy with a random debuff. Maximum of 5 stacks.
CONDDESC_MINION_ZOMBIE: At the start of this minion's master's turn, each Zombies deals damage to a random enemy equal to 50% of its attack. Maximum of 9 stacks.
CONDDESC_MINION_CONQUEST: After Conquest's master manually casts a spell, it grants all your creatures a random buff.
CONDDESC_MINION_FAMINE: After Famine's master attacks, it decreases the target's Maximum health by an amount equal to 30% of the damage dealt.
CONDDESC_MINION_WAR: After War's master is damaged, it deals damage to the enemy equal to 50% of the damage taken.
CONDDESC_MINION_DEATH: At the start of Death's master's turn, it has a chance to kill the enemy with the lowest health. The chance is increased based on how low the enemy's health is.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_BLEED: Creatures with Bleeding take damage equal to 30% of their Current health at the start of each turn.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_BOMB: At the start of a creature's turn, its Bomb detonates, dealing damage to the creature equal to 80% of the afflictor's speed. Then, this debuff is removed.
CONDDESC_MINION_SPIDERLING: After this minion's master takes damage from an enemy, each of its Spiderlings explode, dealing damage to the enemy equal to 50% of the master's Current health. Maximum of 9 stacks.
CONDDESC_BUFF_DEFENSIVE: Creatures with Defensive automatically defend at the end of their turn.
CONDDESC_BUFF_IMMUNITY: Creatures with Immune can't be afflicted with debuffs.
CONDDESC_BUFF_TAUNT: Creatures with Taunting automatically provoke at the end of their turn.
CONDDESC_BUFF_PROTECT: Creatures with Protected take 50% less damage.
CONDDESC_BUFF_REPELLING: Repelling creatures have a 50% chance to ignore damage from spells.
CONDDESC_BUFF_MEND: Creatures with Mending recover 30% health at the start of their turn.
CONDDESC_BUFF_LEECH: Creatures with Leeching recover health equal to 25% of the damage they deal.
CONDDESC_BUFF_ARCANE: When an Arcane creature casts a spell, the spell does not consume any charges. Then, this buff is removed.
CONDDESC_BUFF_WARD: Creatures with Warded cannot lose stats.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_INVERTED: Inverted creatures heal enemies instead of damaging them with attacks and spells, and damage allies instead of healing them. This debuff is removed after enough damage or healing has been done to offset its potency.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_CURSED: When creatures with Cursed deal damage with attacks or spells, they take damage equal to 100% of their target's attack.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_BLIND: Blind creatures cannot choose their targets when attacking or casting single-target spells.
CONDDESC_MINION_DOPPELGANGER: The Doppelganger's master has a 25% chance to take an extra turn.
CONDDESC_MINION_AMALGAMATION: After the Amalgamation's master deals damage with an attack or spell, this minion deals damage to a random enemy equal to 5% of its master's highest stat multiplied by the number of minions it has.
CONDDESC_DEBUFF_POISON: Creatures with Poisoned take damage based on the inflictor's attack each turn.
CONDDESC_MINION_BRIMFIEND: When this minion's master attacks, it sacrifices each Brim Fiends to increase its damage by 50% per stack. Maximum of 9 stacks. This minion is a Lesser Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_FIREIMP: When this minion's master casts a spell, it sacrifices each Fire Imps to increase its potency by 30% per stack. Maximum of 9 stacks. This minion is a Lesser Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_CHAOSSATYR: After this minion's master defends or provokes, it sacrifices each Chaos Satyrs to deal damage to enemies equal to 15% of its highest stat per stack. Maximum of 9 stacks. This minion is a Lesser Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_ASMODEUS: When Asmodeus' master attacks, it always deals critical damage, cannot be dodged, and damages all other enemies for 50% less damage. This minion is a Greater Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_BEELZEBUB: When Beelzebub's master kills an enemy, it gains a random Greater Demon. This minion is a Greater Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_MAMMON: When Mammon's master takes damage, the damage is reduced by 2% for each stack of each Lesser Demon it has. This minion is a Greater Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_LEVIATHAN: When Leviathan's master kills an enemy, it gains 5 stacks of each Lesser Demon. This minion is a Greater Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_BELPHEGOR: When Belphegor's master casts a single-target spell, it targets all the creatures fighting on the target's side. This minion is a Greater Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_SATANACHIA: At the end of Satanachia's master's turn, it casts the last 3 spells creatures cast in the current battle. This minion is a Greater Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_LUCIFER: At the start of Lucifer's master's turn, it attacks random enemies 3 times. This minion is a Greater Demon.
CONDDESC_MINION_MICROBOT: At the end of this minion's master's turn, each Microbots deals damage to a random enemy equal to 50% of its intelligence. Maximum of 9 stacks.
